description: Looking for a dependable blanket that’ll withstand consistent outdoor use? As a staple of the U.S. Military for reliable warmth and protection, wool blankets help you brave the elements during camping trips, outdoor adventures, tailgate parties, festivals and concerts, or during any day-to-day use. Our Plaid Wool Blankets easily conquer the wildness, giving you a place to relax and enjoy the moment. A Spark of Ingenuity: These outdoor military wool blankets are made of a natural fire-retardant material. Pack it along with your other survival gear, as it doubles as an emergency blanket. The plaided pattern adds a flare of personality and style. Built to Last: Constructed with a heavyweight, yet breathable and synthetic woold blend, these camping blankets provide instant warmth, even on the go. These warm wool blankets are designed to keep you dry and insulate your body heat. The Pico stitching around the edges also aids in the rugged, long-lasting use of these outdoor throw blankets. Limitless Applications & Uses: These outdoor emergency blankets work well in a variety of environments, including sand and snow. Whether it’s to help keep you dry as you dig out your car’s tire on a cold winter day, or lounge around on the beach as you wait for the grill, these outdoor camping blankets are great to keep on hand, especially for those with active lifestyles. The Perfect Size: Our easily transportable blankets are perfect to use alone or with another person, and measure 62 inch X 80 inch (fitting most cots). Even with a heavyweight composition, these blankets are easy to fold and compact. Conveniently store it in your backpack, survival bag, or car.
